description.en-US: The English of a priest of Mount Melleray (Ailbe Luddy; Dublin, Browne and Nolan, 1921) of the five books De consideratione, Bernard's advice to Pope Eugene III: the author's preface and the sixty-one chapters, with the chapter summaries as titles. The Latin book's chapters match, and the Oxford English of George Lewis (1908) sits in that book; this second English is a separate book of the same work.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa de um sacerdote de Mount Melleray (Dublin, 1921) dos cinco livros De consideratione de São Bernardo ao papa Eugênio III.

en-US.translator: A priest of Mount Melleray (Ailbe Luddy)

sources.edition: St. Bernard's Treatise on Consideration, translated by a priest of Mount Melleray (Dublin: Browne and Nolan, 1921).
sources.description: Djvu OCR cleaned by script, not proofread. The long introduction, the translator's notes (dropped because the OCR runs them into the page text) and the appendix (Letter CCXXXVII to the Roman Curia) are not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1921, before 1931: public domain in the US.
